decisions.reason: The product has been actively developed and positively described, suggesting results meet aspirations and the firm has slack to keep it.
Continued investment in EU Stage V compliance indicates commitment and satisfactory performance, making a drop unlikely.
The product line has its own page and ongoing support, implying it meets internal expectations and is worth retaining.
The new CERON generation sets standards and has specific applications, pointing to performance above aspirations and low drop risk.
